info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Documents-v4-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Documents Retrieval API facilitates the access and retrieval of documents associated with career applications. This endpoint allows users to efficiently list all documents related to job applications, ensuring that necessary information is readily available. Typical consumers include hiring managers and recruitment teams looking to review applicant documentation. With this API, organizations can streamline the hiring process by centralizing access to application materials, enhancing operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents associated with applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch all documents that are linked to applications in the system. Users can use this information to view, manage, and analyze application documents effectively.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving application documents. This body should contain the necessary parameters and filters to specify which documents are being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of documents.
